bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears finalized their 53-man roster ahead of the 2026 season, with the biggest move being a trade that sent defensive tackle Gervon Dexter Sr. out of town to Atlanta for Clark Phillips III .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions finalized their 2026 initial 53-man roster and then announced 14 additions to the practice squad on Monday as they continue building out the depth chart. Meanwhile, the team's roster situation is complicated by safeties Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch remaining on PUP, meaning they must miss games to start the 2026 season .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers' offseason was overshadowed by news that running back Josh Jacobs has been placed on the Commissioner's Exempt list pending an investigation into alleged domestic violence charges. Meanwhile, the team continued shaping its roster after cutdown day, including a trade in which former Green Bay Packers quarterback Kyle McCord was traded to the Miami Dolphins in exchange for a 2028 6th-round pick .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings finalized their 53-man roster for the 2026 season, surprisingly keeping four quarterbacks—Kyler Murray, Carson Wentz, J.J. McCarthy, and Max Brosmer—while notably lacking depth at pass rusher.
